method: A B B A A B; each run verifies outputs, warms up once, then samples five processes; 8192 rows, eight-row pages, ten executions and 2000 compilations per sample. Frozen binaries, same compiler/build mode, fixture, manifest and harness.
limits: Shared host, installed recovery active; finite component timings only. No native or transport latency claim.
